entries.zh: 县官（知县，治理一县的长官）
entries.en: county magistrate; mandarin who governs a district

entries.zh: 群臣（众多官员的总称）
entries.en: crowd of ministers; many mandarins

entries.zh: 经历（官署中掌文书案牍的首领官，职任佐理长官）
entries.en: registrar or secretary handling documents in a government office; mandarin like an alcalde mayor

entries.zh: 检刑（职司刑名审断、得行司法之官）
entries.en: official empowered to try cases and administer justice

entries.zh: 三法司（刑部、大理寺、都察院三大司法衙门及其长官）
entries.en: the Three Judicial Offices (Board of Punishments, Court of Judicial Review, Censorate)
entries.notes: 西语释义“一城之官”与汉字“三法司”不合，疑系串行误置；释义从汉字与闽南语音写。

entries.zh: 尚书（六部长官，位比公爵的重臣；原件旁注第二等爵位）
entries.en: grand minister, president of one of the Six Boards (like a duke); second dignity
entries.notes: 音写栏多出 Lion sy 两音节，未详所指，或系别字混入；其余三栏互证清晰。

entries.zh: 增膳司（掌增备御膳、供事王厨之司）
entries.en: office aiding the king's kitchen; in charge of furnishing the royal meals

entries.zh: 指挥（明代卫所武职，统兵之官）
entries.en: military commander (Ming garrison commander); mandarin over soldiers

entries.zh: 正印官（掌正印、实任其职之官，非代理）
entries.en: substantive mandarin holding the official seal; office-holder in his own right, not an acting appointee

entries.zh: 缙绅（插笏垂绅的在任官员，泛指官绅士大夫）
entries.en: the mandarinate or gentry; officials with the sash

entries.zh: 台官（御史台台谏之官；或作台宦，泛指高官大员）
entries.en: great mandarin; censorial court official (text uncertain, possibly grand dignitary)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标[疑]（台官/台宦），音写后字更近“宦”，未能定夺。

entries.zh: 提牵（疑为提举，掌稽查簿册、验放出纳之官）
entries.en: mandarin who inspects the registers and leads out; probably a superintendent
entries.notes: 汉字标[疑]（提牵/提举），西语 registra los centos y sale 疑为 censos 之讹，语义只得大概。

entries.zh: 三朝元老（历仕三朝、久侍君王的老臣）
entries.en: elder statesman who has served three reigns; veteran minister of the king

entries.zh: 都堂（都御史、总督之尊称，位临诸督抚之上）
entries.en: grand title of a Censorate president or viceroy-general, standing over the viceroys

entries.zh: 士夫（士大夫；公事完毕归家的任官士人）
entries.en: scholar-official of the gentry, who returns home when his office is done

entries.zh: 一品（官阶第一品之最高官员）
entries.en: mandarin of the first rank (first dignity)

entries.zh: 国老（国之元老重臣）
entries.en: elder statesman of the realm

entries.zh: 二品（官阶第二品之官员）
entries.en: mandarin of the second rank (second dignity)

entries.zh: 尚书（正二品大员，六部长官；承上条为第二品之例）
entries.en: Board president, grand minister of the second dignity

entries.zh: 三品（官阶第三品之官员）
entries.en: mandarin of the third rank (third dignity)

entries.zh: 侍郎（六部副长官，正三品；承上条为第三品之例）
entries.en: vice-president of a Board, dignity of the third rank
entries.notes: 仅“郎”字声调号污損（T99），汉字与音写本身清晰、释义无疑；按封存件受损标记规程记低置信。

entries.zh: 四品（官阶第四品之官员）
entries.en: mandarin of the fourth rank (fourth dignity)
entries.notes: 西语截断 quarta dig 须按系列推断补全；音写多出 cun būn 两音节未详所指。
